questions.stem: What is the key difference between the keys used in encoding and the keys used in encryption?
options: Encoding keys are longer than encryption keys
Encoding keys are used publicly by unknown entities, while encryption keys are used by known entities
Encoding keys expire, while encryption keys do not
Encoding uses no key at all
questions.explanation: Encryption and decryption keys are used by known entities or individuals, whereas encoding and decoding keys are used publicly by unknown entities.

questions.stem: Who or what normally performs data encoding and decoding?
options: Business users through a BI tool
questions.explanation: Encoding and decoding are normally used by programs or systems internally, whereas encryption and decryption are used by proprietary, expensive software.

questions.stem: Which example illustrates the analog-data-to-digital-signal encoding technique?
options: A microphone connected directly to speakers
A microphone connected to a computer for recording
A computer sending sound to speakers
A computer transferring a file to another computer
A radio tuned to an analog station
questions.explanation: Analog data to digital signals is used when the sender is analog and the receiver is digital, such as a microphone feeding a computer for recording.

questions.stem: Which example illustrates digital data being encoded to analog signals?
questions.explanation: Digital data to analog signals applies when the sender is digital and the receiver is analog, such as sound going from a computer to speakers.

questions.stem: A microphone connected directly to speakers is an example of which encoding technique?
questions.explanation: Analog data to analog signals is used when both sender and receiver are analog compatible, like a microphone connected directly to speakers.

questions.stem: What values does a digital signal carry?
options: Positive and negative voltages of any size
questions.explanation: A digital signal carries only 0 and 1 values, unlike an analog signal, which is a continuous range of values.

questions.stem: Which type of signal is used in audio and video?
questions.explanation: Analog signals are used in audio and video, whereas digital signals are used for transmitting computer-generated data sets.

questions.stem: Which statement about breaks in transmission is correct?
options: There can be breaks in analog transmission but not in digital
There cannot be breaks in analog transmission, but there can be in digital transmission
Neither analog nor digital transmission can have breaks
Both analog and digital transmission always have breaks
Breaks occur only when data is encrypted
questions.explanation: There cannot be breaks while transmitting analog data or signals, whereas there can be breaks while transmitting digital data or signals.

questions.stem: What is a signal, in the context of data encoding?
options: A key used to unlock encrypted data
An electromagnetic or electric current that carries data from one location to another
A file format for compressing audio
A software wrapper around a database
A schedule for transferring data overnight
questions.explanation: A signal is an electromagnetic or electric current which carries data or information from one location to another.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the four major encoding techniques?
questions.explanation: The four major techniques pair analog or digital data with analog or digital signals; digital data to optical signals is not one of them.
